repositoryLicense.appliesTo: Repository-derived OpenAPI, Markdown prose, and examples retained by this candidate normalization.
requirements: Retain source attribution and modification provenance.

readme.statement: This repo is published under the Apache 2.0 license.

oasInfoLicense.name: MIT
oasInfoLicense.scope: Preserved as the upstream OAS info.license declaration.

officialGeneratedSdks.scope: Official generated SDK distributions; recorded separately from repository-derived OAS content.

excludedVariant.reason: The SDK-oriented variant has 192 schemas rather than 217 and only 3 EventCallback-prefixed schemas rather than 27, so it is not the complete product contract.

removed.reason: The self-contained Fern source embeds language-specific SDK snippets containing authentication placeholders; they are documentation-generator display inputs, not part of the HTTP contract.

contractEquivalence.method: The importer resolves the legacy source's external Markdown and JSON references, removes x-codeSamples and display-only prose metadata from both sources, canonicalizes legacy x-webhooks and Fern webhooks by operationId, then requires exact equality for paths, components, security, servers, tag identifiers, and webhook contracts.

filledEmptySchemaDescriptions.method: Copy the exact official description from the sole operation that uses each request Schema.

derivedEnrichment.scope: Pontx-owned display labels, enum literal labels, safe examples, and unambiguous schema corrections; none of these additions are represented as upstream prose or provider-authored examples.

enumDescriptions.method: Literal-preserving labels only; no provider semantics are inferred.

leafExamples.method: Prefer declared const/default/enum evidence, otherwise generate deterministic type- and constraint-valid values only when the field name or format provides a meaningful safe mapping; generic unconstrained strings are omitted rather than assigned a placeholder.
leafExamples.omissionReason: Binary bodies, credentials, secrets, generic strings without a meaningful field/format mapping, and schemas without a safely inferable scalar type do not receive fabricated examples.

constraintCorrections: Removed stale required member options from components.schemas.SubFormFieldsPerDocumentText.allOf[1] because neither the variant nor its base declares an options property.

directoryRegistration.reason: The pinned source has 12 declared top-level tags but five operations use the otherwise undeclared Fax tag; the derived registration makes that upstream grouping discoverable without changing any operation tag.

pontxExtensions.requestExamples: Derived only from declared parameter examples/defaults; required provider state, sensitive values, and request bodies remain unresolved.
pontxExtensions.proxyPolicy: All endpoints are permanently disabled in the Hub proxy. Direct SDK/CLI calls use caller-owned credentials; the CLI requires a request-bound, five-minute confirmation token for all mutations.

localization.method: Official prose uses the existing machine-assisted translation with protected code spans, link targets, URLs, and provider names; Pontx-derived titles and literal enum labels use the deterministic bilingual rules in the importer.
